diagnosis: The HandleDispatch background worker loads and sends marketing SMS campaigns based solely on CampaignID from the queue payload without re-verifying that UserID owns the campaign. An attacker can trigger premature or unapproved broadcast campaigns created by other enterprise clients, causing financial cost and reputational damage.

POST /api/campaigns/trigger-dispatch HTTP/1.1
Host: messaging.twilio-partner.io
Authorization: Bearer client_token_881
Content-Type: application/json

{"campaign_id": "cmp_confidential_announcement"}
